name: Nippon Life India Asset Management Ltd
title: Nippon Life India Asset Management Ltd - 540767 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: AMC posted record FY26 PAT of INR 15.29 bn (+19% YoY) and market share of 8.89%, but Q4 SIP net inflows have flattened and Q4 PAT fell 5% QoQ on negative other income.

triggers.label: SIP book flat, net inflows stalled
triggers.quote: the SIP net inflow which is coming in industry has sort of flattened. We are also sort of seeing a similar trend in our case.

triggers.label: Expense growth guided 15-16% ex-ESOP
triggers.quote: our guidance will still remain in the range of around 15% -16% YoY ex of ESOP

guidance.quote: our guidance will still remain in the range of around 15% -16% YoY ex of ESOP

guidance.metric: SIP-based stable market share and growth
guidance.quote: Hopefully that will keep giving us slightly better net sales growth as we go ahead from here on.

red_flags.label: SEBI fine overhang unresolved
red_flags.quote: we do not have anything new to disclose other than that has been disclosed to the stock exchanges

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT down 5% QoQ, other income negative
red_flags.quote: Other Income stood at negative INR 0.34 bn, lower both YoY & QoQ – due to market volatility.

evasions.quote: while yes we have not formally launched our product
At this point of time, we do not have anything new to disclose
